effort: Redirect toward an angled opening while preserving a controlled outside plant.
brief: Consolidate the first three classes through a simple two-choice angled route. E1 is the fork-cut anchor. The supporting jobs are a discrete oblique plant, an elastic return, shared-foot acceptance after a lateral push, reverse-travel braking and ground-based lateral force release. No feints or late second cue are added today.
anchor_protocol: Use a measured Y inside an up-to-10 m long × 7 m wide clear rectangle, including a 2 m clear stopping extension beyond either branch. Athlete approaches 1.5 m at a controlled jog; a coach, outside both routes and visible ahead, commits left/right before the junction. Athlete takes that 45-degree branch for 1.5 m, then stops inside its 2 m buffer. Two trials each side in hidden order. If branch control is unproven, cue before the approach and use a slower entry; retain the same angled drill and dose.
quality_marker: E1: four correct branch choices, foot/knee pointing consistently through the cut and controlled stopping. Record entry speed description, cue location and side; do not compare time with the linear or lateral drills.
layout: Lane widths are not known: verify a combined clear footprint for the Y, not just three painted lanes. Every approach/branch/buffer must fit within 10 m longitudinally. Close all crossing traffic and reserve the combined bay. E5 backpedals from 6 m to 4 m and stops by 2 m, face/route checked before departure. E6 throws along a reserved lane from 2 m into a low 2–7 m landing zone; no return catch, no athlete crossing the ball path. If the angled bay cannot be cleared, the class cannot be delivered as written until space is resolved. Full-route width is a requirement, not confirmed inventory: branch stopping extensions can exceed a 4 m bay. Compact same-drill option, use instead of the full-width routes: for E1 use a 0.75 m controlled approach, 1 m branch and 1 m stopping buffer, keeping the 45-degree choice and four trials. Orient the branches within the 10 m length and verify a 4 m-wide clear bay including body margins. E2/E3/E4 already use short individualized flight distances. Record reduced travel (7 m approach/branch total plus 4 m stopping across E1) separately. At setup, mark complete body/landing envelopes, both possible routes, run-off and the coach position; a floor-line diagram alone does not establish clearance. If even the compact footprint is unavailable, resolve the layout before delivery.
progression: Previous: Class 3 prescribed a feint/hold problem and four unilateral forward landings; no response supplied. Current: four simple fork reads, only one oblique bound landing/side and one rebound-return pair, and fewer primary sets. Retain RDL and calf/adductor loads without escalation. Cossack and lateral step-up are newly calibrated through prep sets, not presumed familiar or stronger. Advance route entry speed only when actual foot placement, stops and recovery support it; keep cue timing simple if any uncertainty remains.
audit: Consolidation is a lower decision count and modest strength allocation, not a repeated drill. Oblique bound, lateral rebound-return and unilateral-to-bilateral acceptance have different contact/force tasks. Y geometry and throwing clearance are explicit unresolved space requirements; no extra 30 m runway is assumed. Next class changes orientation to retreat/reopen without stacking faster cuts on this workload. Audit revision: initial unilateral allocation was eight landings, which conflicted with consolidation intent. Reduced oblique bounds and rebound-return to four combined unilateral landings while keeping all six slots meaningful. Geometry revision: removed the implication that every full-length angled route fits a 4 m-wide rectangle; added a quantified shorter same-drill alternative. Default ledger totals remain the full-route prescription; compact actual travel is logged separately.

explosive.name: Opponent Fork-Cut Read
explosive.job: Main live choice of an angled path from a controlled approach.
explosive.execution: Jog 1.5 m, take a 1.5 m 45-degree branch after the coach’s body commitment, stop within 2 m. Rest 60 s between trials and 90 s before E2. Cue earlier or slow the approach for a poor plant.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: 45-Degree Cut Bound to Stick
explosive.job: Practice redirecting an oblique impulse across one outside plant, separately from a reactive running decision.
explosive.execution: Use one controlled step into a planted foot, bound 45 degrees to the opposite-leg landing and hold 2 s. Short distance, no approach sprint. Rest 30 s between bounds, 60 s before E3. Reduce angle/distance if knee/foot rotation is uncontrolled.

explosive.name: Skater Rebound-Return
explosive.job: Reverse force from one leg to the other without the terminal landing pause of Class 1’s skater bound.
explosive.execution: Bound right-to-left and immediately left-to-right once; each leg receives one landing. Keep travel small and stop after the second landing. Rest 60 s before E4. Reduce distance for long uncontrolled ground contact.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Lateral Single-Leg Takeoff to Two-Foot Landing
explosive.job: Share landing acceptance across both feet while preserving a unilateral lateral push; consolidates force production at lower landing asymmetry.
explosive.execution: Push sideways from one leg, land with both feet together in time and hold 2 s; two attempts per takeoff leg. Rest 30 s between attempts, 60 s before E5. Shorten distance for uneven landing.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Backpedal-to-Stick
explosive.job: Own the brake when momentum is travelling backward, supporting the next retreat/reopen exposure.
explosive.execution: Backpedal sharply but under control for 2 m; stop over the next ≤2 m, hold 2 s. Keep hips loaded and head facing forward; precheck the route. Rest 45 s between reps, 60 s before E6. Slow down if feet tangle or stopping drifts.

explosive.name: Stationary Lateral Medicine-Ball Scoop Heave
explosive.job: Transfer leg/hip force sideways into a free release while both feet support the athlete.
explosive.execution: Light ball held near outside hip, shallow hip load, drive through the floor and release sideways with two hands; pivot the feet with the hips, no planted-knee twist. No jump/catch. Rest 30 s between throws, 90 s before strength. Reduce load if the release slows.

stabilization.name: Lateral Step-Down — light dumbbell
stabilization.job: Light control of the outside knee/pelvis before loaded lateral patterns.
stabilization.execution: Lower for 3 s from a suitably low stable platform, free heel lightly taps; keep standing heel down. Use bodyweight or reduce range for pelvic/knee drift. If no platform fits, use a shallow supported single-leg squat instead, same dose. Rest 30 s between sides/holds and 30 s before the next exercise. Stay at RPE 3–4/10, at least five clean reps or ample hold time in reserve.

stabilization.name: Seated Band Ankle Eversion — light
stabilization.job: Low-fatigue ankle control over an oblique plant; keep band work well below primary-strength effort.
stabilization.execution: With heel supported and shin still, turn the forefoot slightly outward against a light band held securely by the coach, away from the face. Return slowly; no ankle rolling or knee turn. Reduce tension/range for loss of control. Rest 30 s between sides/holds and 30 s before the next exercise. Stay at RPE 3–4/10, at least five clean reps or ample hold time in reserve.

primary.name: Cossack Squat — goblet dumbbell
primary.job: Fixed-stance lateral hip force through a controlled range, calibrated as a new strength anchor.
primary.execution: Start in a fixed wide stance; shift into one hip, bend that knee and keep the other leg long, then return to centre without stepping. Use a comfortable depth; reduce range for groin pain or heel roll. Rest 90 s between sides; 120 s between rounds and 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 3/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
primary.job: Single-leg push and controlled descent for accepting weight over an angled plant.
primary.execution: Use a stable box below the point where the pelvis tilts; whole lead foot supported. Drive up without a trailing-leg hop and step down under control. Lower box/load if the return drops. If no box fits, use floor-supported Split Squat instead at the same sets/reps per leg, 2–3 RIR, with no other split-squat slot in this class. Rest 90 s between sides; 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 3/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Romanian Deadlift — two dumbbells
primary.job: Retain hip-hinge force with one set during this consolidation exposure.
primary.execution: Hinge from standing with soft knees; keep weights close and stop descent where the pelvis/spine remain controlled. Finish tall without leaning back. Reduce range/load for rounding. Rest 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 bilateral easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Copenhagen Plank — Short Lever
primary.job: Adductor support against lateral separation with no hold-time progression.
primary.execution: Upper knee bent about 90 degrees on a stable bench, forearm under shoulder; lift the lower leg and keep pelvis level. Select a short lever with about 5 seconds clean hold reserve. Stop for groin, shoulder or knee pain. If bench/support is unsuitable, use side-lying hip adduction instead, 1 × 8/side at 2–3 RIR; record changed hold/repetition totals. For that replacement, prepare with 1 × 4 easy reps/side instead of the two 5 s preparation holds; retain side rest. Rest 60 s between sides; 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 s/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.

primary.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise — supported standing, dumbbell
primary.job: Maintain straight-knee ankle strength while limiting rebound overlap.
primary.execution: Stand on flat floor with a nearly straight knee and light hand support; raise the heel, pause briefly and lower for 2 seconds. No bounce or ankle roll. Reduce load when heel height declines. Rest 60 s between sides; 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 3/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.

primary.name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise — bilateral, bent-knee
primary.job: Maintain bent-knee ankle strength at a modest support dose.
primary.execution: Use a stable bench, knees near right angles, secure dumbbells on distal thighs above knees. Lower heels for 2 seconds to the floor, pause, then rise. Reduce load for bouncing or shortened range. Rest 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 bilateral easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.
